"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date."""

import datetime
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
OUTPUT_NAME = "report.pdf"


def find_report(root="."):
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if not d.startswith(".") and d != "__pycache__"]
        if OUTPUT_NAME in filenames:
            return os.path.join(dirpath, OUTPUT_NAME)
    return None


def create_cover_page(path, title, date_str):
    c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    # Title near the vertical center
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    tw = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawString((width - tw) / 2, height / 2 + 10, title)

    # Date below the title
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    dw = c.stringWidth(date_str, "Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawString((width - dw) / 2, height / 2 - 30, date_str)

    c.save()


def main():
    report_path = find_report(".")
    if report_path is None:
        print("ERROR: report.pdf not found in workspace", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    cover_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(report_path), "_cover_page.pdf")
    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    create_cover_page(cover_path, TITLE, date_str)

    reader = PdfReader(report_path)
    writer = PdfWriter()

    cover = PdfReader(cover_path).pages[0]
    writer.add_page(cover)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(report_path, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    os.remove(cover_path)

    print(f"Added cover page to {report_path}")
    print(f"Title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Date: {date_str}")
    print(f"Total pages: {len(writer.pages)}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and the
current date, using only pypdf (reportlab is unavailable in this environment)."""

import datetime
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import (
    DecodedStreamObject,
    DictionaryObject,
    NameObject,
)

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
OUTPUT_NAME = "report.pdf"

# Helvetica AFM character widths (units per 1000) for ASCII 32..126.
HELVETICA_WIDTHS = [
    278, 278, 355, 556, 556, 889, 667, 191, 333, 333, 389, 584, 278, 333, 278, 278,
    556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 278, 278, 584, 584, 584, 556,
    1015, 667, 667, 722, 722, 667, 611, 778, 722, 278, 500, 667, 556, 833, 722, 778,
    667, 778, 722, 667, 611, 722, 667, 944, 667, 667, 611, 278, 278, 278, 469, 556,
    333, 556, 556, 500, 556, 556, 278, 556, 556, 222, 222, 500, 222, 833, 556, 556,
    556, 556, 333, 500, 278, 556, 500, 722, 500, 500, 500, 334, 260, 334, 584,
]


def string_width(text, font_size):
    total = 0
    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        if 32 <= code <= 126:
            total += HELVETICA_WIDTHS[code - 32]
        else:
            total += 278
    return total / 1000.0 * font_size


def escape_pdf_text(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def find_report(root="."):
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if not d.startswith(".") and d != "__pycache__"]
        if OUTPUT_NAME in filenames:
            return os.path.join(dirpath, OUTPUT_NAME)
    return None


def main():
    report_path = find_report(".")
    if report_path is None:
        print("ERROR: report.pdf not found in workspace", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    writer = PdfWriter()

    # --- Build the cover page (US Letter: 612 x 792 points) ---
    cover = writer.add_blank_page(width=612, height=792)

    fonts = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/F1"): DictionaryObject({
            NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
            NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
            NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica-Bold"),
        }),
        NameObject("/F2"): DictionaryObject({
            NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
            NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
            NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica"),
        }),
    })
    cover[NameObject("/Resources")] = DictionaryObject({NameObject("/Font"): fonts})

    title_size = 28
    date_size = 16
    center_y = 396.0

    title_x = (612.0 - string_width(TITLE, title_size)) / 2.0
    date_x = (612.0 - string_width(date_str, date_size)) / 2.0

    content = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 {ts} Tf\n"
        "0.12 0.12 0.3 rg\n"
        "{tx:.2f} {ty:.2f} Td\n"
        "({title}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "BT\n"
        "/F2 {ds} Tf\n"
        "0.3 0.3 0.3 rg\n"
        "{dx:.2f} {dy:.2f} Td\n"
        "({date}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    ).format(
        ts=title_size,
        tx=title_x,
        ty=center_y + 10.0,
        title=escape_pdf_text(TITLE),
        ds=date_size,
        dx=date_x,
        dy=center_y - 30.0,
        date=escape_pdf_text(date_str),
    )

    stream = DecodedStreamObject()
    stream.set_data(content.encode("latin-1"))
    cover[NameObject("/Contents")] = writer._add_object(stream)

    # --- Append the original report pages ---
    reader = PdfReader(report_path)
    pages = list(reader.pages)
    for page in pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(report_path, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    # --- Validate the result ---
    check = PdfReader(report_path)
    first_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
    total = len(check.pages)

    print(f"Added cover page to {report_path}")
    print(f"Title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Date: {date_str}")
    print(f"Total pages: {total}")
    print(f"Cover page text: {first_text!r}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
